reviews.text: Small clinic with trustworthy, very helpful and attentive staff. My dog ​​Pepe was rescued from the street and is quite easily frightened, becoming very reactive to any kind of veterinary care. This is the only clinic where we can find professionals who are willing to, for example, trim his nails. Dr. Rodrigo, in addition to his incredible competence, is a very sensitive and realistic veterinarian. He doesn't invent unnecessary tests and is very understanding of our dog's limitations. Exceptional!
He's the best veterinarian I know! I trust him completely.

Dr. Rodrigo is an amazing person, always helpful and caring.
I recommend this clinic 100%.
Always showing great care, affection, and attention to both pet and owner. Dr. Rodrigo strives for excellence. 👏👏👏👏🙏🙏🙏🙏 …

Dr. Rodrigo is an excellent professional. His service is personalized, and the clinic has a great structure. In addition, the bathing and grooming services also deserve praise.

I recommend him without hesitation.
I recommend veterinarian Rodrigo. He's been taking care of my pet for some time now, and I trust his work.

Dr. Rodrigo is a great veterinarian and the service at the clinic is very good.
I highly recommend him.
